N_personal_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
N_personal_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
N_personal_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students holding a non-medical (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_personal_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_personal_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

sc_school_immunization.name: South Carolina School Vaccination Coverage
sc_school_immunization.organization: South Carolina Department of Public Health
sc_school_immunization.description: County-level school vaccination coverage and exemption data from SC DPH reports.
sc_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
